data.body: Held-out oracle restored and GREEN: 9 direct tests cover exact layered totals, missing st_blocks, linked-worktree shared scope, inode-deduplicated hard links, fresh-clone amplification over 256 one-byte files, schema validation, read-only state/ref invariants, text labels, and credential-safe failure cleanup. Defect-seeded mutation removed inode deduplication; the hard-link oracle went RED (12288 vs 8192 allocated bytes), then production code was restored. Focused schema/route/oracle suite: 43 passed. make lint and make typecheck are GREEN; generated help and CLI reference checks are GREEN. The first full make test run exposed exactly two in-scope RED tests: both authoritative exit-code census checks reported the new tracker-footprint dispatcher arm undocumented. Added docs/exit-codes.md to file impact before editing; no retry or unrelated failure is being ignored.
